source_caption_text:
King Von & Quando Rondo’s Story Is One Of The Most Tragic Chapters In Modern Hip-Hop. 💔🕊️

What Started With Two Artists Moving In The Same Hip-Hop Circle Eventually Turned Into A Deadly 2020 Confrontation In Atlanta. King Von Was Fatally Shot During An Altercation Involving Quando Rondo’s Camp On November 6, 2020. 

The Aftermath Deepened The Tension Between Their Respective Circles, With Von’s Close Friend Lil Durk and Quando Rondo becoming central figures in the conflict that followed. 

Years Later, The Story Remains A Major Part Of Hip-Hop History — And A Reminder Of How Quickly Rivalries Can Turn Tragic. 🕊️

King Von Was Only 26. 💔
